column1: CLINICAL REVIEW — are these questions ones a perioperative gynecologic nurse would realistically ask during a shift? y/n

column5: question
What IV rate should I keep my post-op urogyn patient on until she's drinking, and when can I stop the fluids?
My post-op patient can't keep anything down and needs stronger pain relief — do I push for a PCA or an epidural, and does it matter what surgery she had?
It's Saturday and my post-op emergency admission needs mobilising — can I get physio and OT in over the weekend or do I have to wait until Monday?
If our surgical scrub sink only has a PCMX product, is that as good as chlorhexidine for scrubbing in?
When exactly should we be giving the prophylactic antibiotic for an elective hysterectomy, and does it cover infections that start after surgery?
My patient is going for a CT with IV contrast before her surgery — what do I need to check and how long should she be NPO?
Our OR runs off an oxygen concentrator instead of pipeline oxygen — what FiO2 should I actually expect it to deliver, and do I still need a cylinder in the room?
My pre-op patient just refused her ordered medication — what do I need to document and who do I have to notify?
For a major PPH, how do I dose carboprost — how much, how often, and what's the max number of doses?

We've got a nursing student on the gynae theatre list this week — the surgeons here don't really do multidisciplinary rounds, so where should I place her to get team experience, and what should I have her do afterwards?
How often should I be emptying my patient's urostomy pouch, and at what point does it need emptying?
When I'm handing off a task in the OR, what's the right way to make sure the person I'm delegating to actually got it?
If one of my post-op patients who's pregnant has a swollen calf and pleuritic chest pain, do I wait for the ultrasound and CTPA results before we start anticoagulation?
For a patient scheduled for a hysterectomy tomorrow morning, when do I tell her to do her pre-op wash, and does it have to be a chlorhexidine product?
My pre-op patient was just started on an antihypertensive plus lifestyle changes — how often should she be getting her BP rechecked, and when can we stretch that out?
If my postpartum patient isn't responding to her first-line antibiotics, when should I be pushing for IV aciclovir to be added?
For our open abdominal gyn-onc cases, what tidal volume and PEEP settings should anesthesia be using to cut down on postoperative lung complications?
For our open abdominal hysterectomy patients, what proportion should actually end up needing a PCA pump, and what should we be using for pain control instead?
If I use a 3% hexachlorophene scrub regularly, how long does its antibacterial effect last and is there any absorption risk I should worry about?
For a myeloma patient on lenalidomide and steroids, what can I give for clot prevention and what aspirin dose, and how long do we keep it going?
For a post-op patient on our ward who I think might be septic, should I be using NEWS2 to score her, or is that only for certain patients?
We've got a suspected environmental outbreak on our surgical unit — do we need to step up cleaning in the OR area, and what agent should we be using?
Ho una paziente in lista per isterectomia che prende metotrexato per artrite reumatoide: dobbiamo sospenderlo prima dell'intervento per ridurre il rischio di infezione della ferita?
My post-C-section patient has suspected sepsis with high risk criteria and a lactate of 4.8 — how fast do I need to get fluids in, and do I need to call critical care?
For our laparoscopic urogyn cases, when should we be injecting local into the port sites — at insertion or at closure?
If a hysterectomy is running long, when do I need to give a second dose of the prophylactic antibiotic?
My post-op hysterectomy patient is starting scheduled oxycodone — when do I need to start a bowel regimen and what do I begin with?
My ovarian cancer patient is really anxious in pre-op and asking for something to calm her down — can I give a sedative before she goes back?
My patient is still on her combined oral contraceptive pill and is going for surgery tomorrow — does she need VTE prophylaxis, and when should it start?
We've got a 35-weeker with severe pre-eclampsia — do we need to deliver her now or can we hold off?
If we bring a peer support worker in to help a patient transition home, what training and supervision should they have in place before they start?
We've got a septic mum at 30 weeks who may need delivering tonight — who makes the call on timing and mode of birth, and what do I need to have ready for the baby and for monitoring in labour?
My hypertensive pre-op patient says she has a glass of wine most nights — what daily and weekly alcohol limit should I be telling her, and how much wine counts as one drink?
A family member keeps using her phone at the bedside in pre-op and then touching the patient — how often should phones be disinfected and what should I tell her?
I'm precepting a nursing student in the OR this week — what am I actually responsible for versus what the school covers?
If our patient's postpartum bleeding isn't settling with IV oxytocin, what's the next drug and dose we should be pulling up?
If the anaesthetist grades our patient's airway as a Mallampati 3 before induction, what do we need to have in place before they start?
For a pregnant patient with nausea and vomiting, is ginger actually any better than vitamin B6 by about day 3 of treatment, or can I tell her either one is fine?
My post-op patient is getting confused and agitated in PACU — what should I be doing at the bedside before I reach for anything sedating?
Our catheter policy lists some items as Category I and others as Category II — do I have to follow the Category II ones exactly, or is there room to individualize for my patient?
Our unit does D&Cs in a small procedure room down the hall — should that room be counted as an operating room when we report our OR numbers?
For our open abdominal hysterectomy patients, what proportion should actually end up needing a PCA pump, and what should we be giving instead?
When I catch a prescribing error before it gets to my patient, is that actually making much difference — what proportion of prescribing errors reach patients anyway?

When I'm handing off a complex post-op patient going from our unit to a long-term care home, is a written discharge summary enough or do I need to actually speak with someone there — and who should that be?
My patient on prophylactic LMWH is booked for an elective section tomorrow morning — when does she get her last dose and how long do we have to wait before anaesthetics can do her spinal?
One of my emergency medical admissions came in overnight — how quickly does she need to be seen by a consultant, and will she still be reviewed over the bank holiday weekend?
My post-op day 1 C-section patient has suspected sepsis but only meets one moderate to high risk criterion — how quickly does she need to be seen, and when do I need to escalate to someone senior?
For a pregnant patient starting treatment-dose enoxaparin for a VTE, which weight do I use to calculate the dose, and is it once or twice daily?
Per una paziente non diabetica in post-operatorio con glicemia alta, quale valore target dovrei tenere e fin dove posso scendere senza rischi?
For our gyn-onc patients with a thoracic epidural, how long can we expect it to actually control pain and cut opioid use, and what do we do if her blood pressure drops?

For my pre-op patient who's frail and end-of-life with a high chance of deteriorating, do I need to get advance care planning started now while she's on the ward, or is that something community services sort out after discharge?
My patient going for a long abdominal case has Graves' disease — is povidone-iodine prep OK for her, or should I pull a different antiseptic?
For a C-section, how quickly after the baby is out do I need to get the uterotonic in, and does giving it mean we can't delay cord clamping?
What haemoglobin levels in pregnancy should prompt investigation and possible iron treatment, and when should we switch from oral to IV iron?
For a patient having an elective knee replacement, what dose of aspirin do we use for VTE prophylaxis and how many days does it run for?
My post-op hysterectomy patient still has her Foley in from surgery yesterday — how soon should it come out if there's no ongoing indication?

When should we be introducing patient safety teaching to the nursing students who rotate through our unit — is it better to wait until they're in their later years and actually handling patients, or start it earlier?
When I'm putting ear drops in an adult in PACU, which way do I pull the pinna and how long do they need to stay lying on that side before I do the other ear?
My post-op hysterectomy patient just got transferred to ICU — how often do I need to recheck her VTE and bleeding risk while she's there?
When I'm writing a problem-focused nursing diagnosis for my post-op patient, what has to be documented before I can call it accurate — and how do I pick what to aim my interventions at?
